summary.text: Tiffany Price is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 26 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tiffany Price earned an associate degree from Metropolitan Community College, Longview.
Her career experience includes founding and serving as executive director of Hold Em Up 4 Care.
Price was assigned to the House Children and Families and Emerging Issues committees for 2025-2026.
